items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Like Timmy Rogers, I remember him, he was in the show there

ctx.x: Well, they were like the house band at --

Yeah. They had had these big shows there. Like Timmy Rogers, I remember him, he was in the show there, and they didn't have any -- they didn't go in for any names, but they had the chorus line and oh, they had singers and comedians, and it was quite a colorful place. Of course the gambling room was upstairs.
